title: Comparative pattern sheet
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 21 (Comparative pattern sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 21: Comparing people: older, younger, taller. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: My brother is taller than my father.

parts.text: tall طَوِيل → root ط و ل → أَطْوَلُ

panels.title: Than me, than you
points: أُخْتِي أَكْبَرُ مِنِّي: my sister is older than me

head: Not this
This
rows: أُمِّي أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِي: use the أَفْعَل form, not the adjective

questions.q: Say: My grandfather is older than my grandmother.
Core: Write five comparisons between members of a family (real or made up).
questions.a: For example: أَبِي أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُمِّي. أَخِي أَطْوَلُ مِنِّي. أُخْتِي أَصْغَرُ مِنِّي. جَدِّي أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أَبِي. أَنَا أَقْصَرُ مِنْ أَخِي.

questions.q: Extend: Compare two things: e.g. the masjid and the house; London and Leeds.
questions.a: For example: المَسْجِدُ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ البَيْتِ. لَنْدَنُ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ لِيدْز.

questions.q: Stretch: Superlative preview: write 'the eldest in my family': أَنَا الأَكْبَرُ فِي أُسْرَتِي.
questions.a: أَنَا الأَكْبَرُ / الكُبْرَى فِي أُسْرَتِي (al- + أَفْعَل = the -est)
B) أُخْتِي أَصْغَرُ مِنِّي. Comparative أَصْغَرُ + مِنْ; it does not take ة.

questions.q: What does أَصْغَرُ مِنْ mean? A) younger than B) taller than C) older than
Big question: compare two people in Arabic.
